posts.text:
Today, Wiki Workers United US/CWA demanded voluntary recognition from the Wikimedia Foundation, the nonprofit organization that hosts Wikipedia and sister projects!

We are hopeful that the Wikimedia Foundation will honor their stated values and quickly come to the table.
posts.summary: Supports worker unionization effort at Wikimedia Foundation
